property_summary: For any callee address whose fallback reverts, the reference contract's forward will propagate that failure (cause the call to revert) only when the low-level call fails; the mutant forcibly treats the call as failed and therefore always reverts for at least some failing callee — so the rule is: forward succeeds exactly when the callee's low-level call returns true, but the mutant can make forward always revert even when the callee call would have succeeded.
change_summary: Flip the boolean assignment to force _s to false regardless of callee.call result, causing forward to revert due to require(_s) while original may have succeeded.
